quote: The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: It never was my thinking that made the big money for me. It always was my sitting.
author: Jesse Livermore

quote: In the short run, the market is a voting machine. In the long run, it's a weighing machine.
author: Benjamin Graham

quote: The four most dangerous words in investing are: 'this time it's different.'
author: Sir John Templeton

quote: Know what you own, and know why you own it.
author: Peter Lynch

quote: The stock market is filled with individuals who know the price of everything, but the value of nothing.
author: Philip Fisher

quote: Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: The trend is your friend until the end when it bends.
author: Ed Seykota

quote: Markets can remain irrational longer than you can remain solvent.
author: John Maynard Keynes

quote: Amateurs think about how much money they can make. Professionals think about how much money they could lose.
author: Jack Schwager

quote: The goal of a successful trader is to make the best trades. Money is secondary.
author: Alexander Elder

quote: Cut your losses short and let your winners run.
author: Trading floor wisdom

quote: It's not whether you're right or wrong, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
author: George Soros

quote: The four most expensive words in the English language are 'this time it's different.'
author: Sir John Templeton

quote: Diversification is protection against ignorance. It makes little sense if you know what you are doing.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: The individual investor should act consistently as an investor and not as a speculator.
author: Benjamin Graham

quote: Every once in a while, the market does something so stupid it takes your breath away.
author: Jim Cramer

quote: Volatility is not the same thing as risk.
author: Howard Marks

quote: The best traders have no ego. You need to swallow your pride and get out of the losses.
author: Tom Baldwin

quote: Successful investing is anticipating the anticipations of others.
author: John Maynard Keynes

quote: If you have to be forced to save, you'll never have enough. You need to want to save.
author: Rakesh Jhunjhunwala

quote: The market is a device to transfer wealth from those who cannot control their emotions to those who can.
author: Attributed principle, markets wisdom

quote: In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable.
author: Robert Arnott

quote: Don't look for the needle in the haystack. Just buy the haystack.
author: John Bogle

quote: The four pillars of investing: discipline, patience, conviction, and humility.
author: Charlie Munger

quote: It's not the will to win that matters — everyone has that. It's the will to prepare to win that matters.
author: Paul Tudor Jones

quote: A market downturn doesn't bother us. It is an opportunity to increase our ownership of great companies.
author: Warren Buffett

quote: Time in the market beats timing the market.
author: Common investing principle

quote: The most important quality for an investor is temperament, not intellect.
author: Warren Buffett
